title: Tafelsig, Mitchells Plain (Paulsberg St, approx.): barber shot dead inside his shop, 20 Oct
summary: Police say a man was shot inside a barbershop in Paulsberg Street, Tafelsig, at about 20:07 on Tuesday 20 October; according to reports, unknown suspects came out of a minibus taxi and shot at him (police, via Cape Times...
story: Police say a man was shot inside a barbershop in Paulsberg Street, Tafelsig, at about 20:07 on Tuesday 20 October; according to reports, unknown suspects came out of a minibus taxi and shot at him (police, via Cape Times). He was declared dead at the scene. Mitchells Plain police registered a murder case. Police say the motive is unknown, and no arrest has been reported. Cape Times describes him as a well-known local barber. One report found, resting on police: Cape Times (IOL). A resident quoted in the same article calls the shooting gang-related; police do not. This is not the burnt body found in Tafelsig on 17 October, which is a separate pin.
